justification: Adds Chrome and curl_cffi to the monitor image and a switch that runs a read-only measurement instead of the monitor; the monitor itself is unchanged.

pre_impl.existing_data: 17 councils answer 403 to Railway (latest finished run). From GitHub's machines (2026-10-25): list pages 11/16 got through with curl_cffi or Chrome; PDFs 5/5 once Chrome visited the council page first.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: GitHub's addresses may be treated differently from Railway's; the fallback is only worth building if it works from Railway.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New switch beside DCP_MONITOR_FORCE; new one-off script.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: the switch runs the probe for any value other than exactly 1, or for another job, or a challenge page counts as a list
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Sol found 3 issues on the first push (switch left on is silent, challenge page counted, inline PDF counted blocked); all fixed with tests.

functions.name: monitor_cmd
functions.input: job name, its command and the environment
functions.output: the probe command when DCP_PROBE_BLOCKED is exactly 1 for dcp-monitor, else as before
functions.if_none: unset switch leaves the command unchanged

break_it.scenario: The switch is left on after the measurement
break_it.what_happens: the daily check would stop running
break_it.how: the probe always exits 1 so run_monitors alerts on Telegram; no_run_2d also goes red

break_it.scenario: A firewall answers 200 with a challenge page
break_it.how: a list page needs at least 3 PDF links

break_it.scenario: Chrome makes the image too big or the build fails on Railway
break_it.what_happens: monitor deploy fails, runs older image
break_it.how: check_railway_jobs_ran goes red on a failed deploy; revert the PR

real_layer_exempt.scripts/probe_blocked_councils.py: It IS the real-layer measurement; it runs on Railway once.

post_merge.manual_verify: railway variables --set DCP_PROBE_BLOCKED=1 -s dcp-monitor --skip-deploys; railway restart; read PROBE lines; then railway variable delete DCP_PROBE_BLOCKED.
